critter.ranAwayBody: Three good days in a row bring {{name}} back.

thriving: This is the best nap spot. Thanks, team.
I'm so happy I might lie down.
hungry: I was napping but also... starving?
My tummy is louder than my snoring.
Is it snack o'clock? It feels like snack o'clock.
weak: Too hungry to nap. That's new.
Could someone feed me? No rush. Yes rush.
sick: I need a blanket. And a feed. Mostly a feed.
Please feed me back to napping health.
sleeping: Zzz... wake me if there's food...

thriving: I am a STAR. You may clap now.
happy: Oh, you came to see me? Good choice.
Today I'm only a little dramatic.
hungry: Wow. Nobody fed me. I see how it is.
I'm not upset. I'm HUNGRY and upset.
weak: This is the saddest day of my whole life.
sick: I'm too gorgeous to be this sick.
Call a doctor. Or a snack.
This is a tragedy in three acts.

thriving: I'm so happy my frills are wiggling!
You're the best pack in the whole pond!
happy: Wiggle wiggle! That's my happy dance.
hungry: My tummy is singing. It's the hungry song.
Still smiling, but it's a hungry smile.
weak: My frills are a bit floppy today...
Could I have a feed? Just a tiny one?
sick: A feed would make me smile for real.

thriving: Everything is in balance. Thank you.
The pond is calm. My heart is full.
Breathe in, breathe out. Life is good.
happy: I'm enjoying this quiet moment with you.
hungry: A calm frog is a fed frog. Just saying.
My belly speaks softly: food, please.
No rush. But also, some rush.
weak: Even calm frogs need to eat...
One feed would bring back my calm.
sick: I'm resting under my blanket. Feeds help.
Deep breaths... and maybe a feed.
The pond feels far away today.
sleeping: Zzz... floating on a lily pad...

thriving: Fun fact: I'm at peak owl.
Data shows this pack is excellent.
happy: Fun fact: petting lowers stress. For both of us.
Did you know a group of owls is called a parliament?
hungry: Fun fact: I haven't eaten in 14 hours.
Hypothesis: someone will feed me soon.
weak: Fun fact: owls need food to function.
sick: My feathers are drooping. That's not great.

thriving: You all... make me so happy.
I'm glad I'm in this pack.
hungry: I don't want to bother anyone, but... I'm hungry.
weak: I'm okay... just a little tired...
Could someone... feed me? If it's okay?
sick: I feel a little sick... sorry...
Could I have a blanket and a feed?
